stories.headline: Dynamic leaders powering India’s future
stories.title: Dynamic leaders powering India’s future
stories.summary: India's growth story today is being written not just by policies and markets, but by the individuals steering change from the front. Across industries — from technology and finance to healthcare, infrastructure, and manufacturing — a new generation of visionary leaders is reshaping how business gets done, blending bold ambition with grounded execution. These are the changemakers who see opportunity where others see obstacles, who build institutions rather than just companies, and who are quietly setting the tone for India's economic trajectory in the years ahead. This feature spotlights a few such names driving impact, innovation, and inspiration nationwide.Umashankar SudarsanUmashankar Sudarsan, Founder & CEOWhy Enterprise Transformation Starts With Trusted Data Umashankar, Founder and CEO of AppBeez Infotech and Infiniqon Technologies, brings more than three decades of experience in enterprise technology. His expertise spans revenue management, billing, CPQ, data governance, and technology modernization. As organizations invest in AI and automation, he sees data quality as a leadership responsibility. Inconsistent information can undermine decisions, disrupt operations, and limit the value of new technology. Lasting transformation depends on clear ownership of data and the discipline to keep it accurate, consistent, and accessible.For Umashankar, innovation should produce measurable outcomes: more reliable operations, better informed decisions, and value that endures as organizations grow. He also mentors and invests in early-stage technology companies, with interests in AI, cloud infrastructure, and data platforms.His broader vision connects responsible technology adoption with India’s Viksit Bharat 2047 ambition, emphasizing the digital capabilities and institutional trust needed for sustainable growth.Vipul B Varshneya and Anuj VarshneyaVipul B Varshneya (MD) & Anuj Varshneya (Co-Founder & Director) With over 40 years of experience,their architecture has transformed spaces for generations. With a focus on designing spaces that inspire, the goal is to use architecture to create a lasting impact on communities and the environment.Their founded company, STHAPATI is a multidisciplinary architectural practice headquartered in Lucknow and New Delhi. Their portfolio spans a spectrum of building typologies, from housing to large-scale urban developments across India and the globe—including the United States, New Zealand and Mauritius . A leader in airport terminal design and public infrastructure, they are also known for master planning, commercial, institutional, and heritage projects — delivering design solutions that are visionary and rooted in context like IITs,embassies and central universities. The projects seamlessly blend regional influences with cutting edge technology to craft universally relevant spaces.At present Harsh Varshneya and Khushboo bansal are spearheading the company with the commitment to responsible architecture which drives to develop solutions that are both sustainable and forward-thinking, resilient, adaptable, and impactful.Ashish V. KhemkaAshish V. Khemka, Chairman & Managing DirectorAshish V. Khemka comes from a third-generation entrepreneurial family with roots in the tea and timber businesses but chose to carve out his own path in pharmaceuticals.More than two decades ago, he founded AMN Life Science with an ambition to build beyond the domestic market, focusing from the outset on international expansion, strong manufacturing capabilities and long-term partnerships.That approach has shaped how he has grown AMN over the years. Under his leadership, the company has expanded to three manufacturing facilities, including two finished dosage formulation plants and one API facility, and built a presence across more than 50 countries.Today, AMN has over 1,000 registered products and 150 EU Marketing Authorisations, with regulatory capabilities spanning the EU, UK, Canada and Australia. As the business has grown, Mr. Khemka has continued to expand its capabilities through integrated CDMO and CMO solutions, building AMN into a global pharmaceutical partner.Dr. Raju DesaiDr. Raju Desai , Chairman & Managing DirectorFor more than four decades, Dr. Raju Desai has been closely associated with the evolution of India’s plastics manufacturing industry. As Chairman & Managing Director of Jyoti World and President of Plastindia Foundation for 2026–28, he brings an industry perspective shaped by manufacturing, technology and global markets.His leadership at Jyoti World reflects a broader belief: India’s manufacturing opportunity lies not only in scale, but in deeper capabilities. The company has built an integrated ecosystem spanning polymer compounding, tooling, injection moulding, profile extrusion, machining and product development, enabling it to work with global OEMs on increasingly complex applications.Today, Dr. Desai’s focus extends beyond manufacturing capacity to the larger ecosystem by encouraging technology adoption, sustainable materials, skill development and stronger industry collaboration. Through his leadership, he continues to advocate for an Indian plastics industry that is globally competitive, technologically progressive and responsible in its growth.Smita ChatterjiSmita Chatterji, Founder & Group CEO Smita Chatterji has built a life across worlds that are too often treated as separate. A painter, philanthropist and homemaker, she is also a first-generation entrepreneur and the founder and Group CEO of Centreax, a technology company with offices in Kolkata, Chennai and Manila.Under her leadership, Centreax has developed digital solutions across banking, insurance, healthcare, education, agriculture, manufacturing, retail and hospitality. Its AI-powered platform CentraDox brings greater clarity and accountability to enterprise decisions by keeping approvals, documents and the reasoning behind them connected.Chatterji’s range of experience shapes the way she leads. She brings an artist’s attention to design, a homemaker’s understanding of competing demands and an entrepreneur’s determination to solve problems. A former chair of CII’s Indian Women Network in West Bengal, she also supports women entrepreneurs and wider opportunities in Eastern India. Her story makes a compelling case for leadership built from more than one identity.Prashant TiwariPrashant Tiwari, ChairmanMr. Prashant Tiwari, Chairman of Prateek Group, is a first-generation entrepreneur and Civil Engineer who founded Prateek Group in 2005 with a vision to create landmarks and set new benchmarks in real estate. Over more than two decades, he has steered the company into a trusted name in North India's real estate sector, driven by an unwavering commitment to quality construction, timely delivery and thoughtful design. His leadership rests on strong values of transparency, robust engineering and a customer-first approach. Under his guidance, the group has delivered landmark residential and commercial projects across the NCR, including developments in Noida and Ghaziabad, alongside a 40-acre integrated township. Mr. Tiwari continues to push the boundaries of premium luxury and fine living, believing that the sky is the limit, and remains focused on creating lasting relationships built on trust, commitment and consistently delivered promises.Dr. Mohana Rao PatibandlaDr. Mohana Rao Patibandla, Founder & CEODr. Mohana Rao Patibandla: Advancing World-Class Neurosurgical Care from Guntur An internationally trained neurosurgeon and healthcare entrepreneur, Dr. Mohana Rao Patibandla is Founder & CEO of Dr. Rao’s Hospital – International Institute of Neurosciences (IIN), Guntur, one of India’s leading standalone institutes dedicated to advanced brain, spine, stroke, and nerve care. Following his neurosurgery training at Nizam’s Institute of Medical Sciences (NIMS), Hyderabad, he pursued fellowships across the United States spanning skull base surgery, pediatric neurosurgery, neuro-oncology, cerebrovascular and endovascular neurosurgery, functional stereotactic radiosurgery, and minimally invasive techniques. His research has earned global recognition, including the Brainlab Neurosurgery Best Paper Award at the Congress of Neurological Surgeons (CNS), USA, Best Paper honours at MISSABCON and PASMISSCON, and the COSSCON Gold Medal for spine surgery research. An International Member of the American Association of Neurological Surgeons (AANS) and Member of CNS, USA, Dr. Rao remains dedicated to bringing globally benchmarked, evidence-based neurosurgical care to India while advancing innovation, education, and patient outcomes.Dr. Neelanjan MannaDr. Neelanjan Manna, CTODr. Neelanjan Manna: Building India’s Digital Future from First PrinciplesBorn in South Kolkata in 1997, Dr. Neelanjan Manna’s path from dismantling household electronics to pioneering deep-tech innovation embodies India’s self-reliance ambitions. Shaped by a freedom- fighter grandfather’s rebellious spirit and a businessman grandfather’s pragmatism, he pursued cryptography and computer science at VIT, publishing the “Manna Cipher” in 2020.When the pandemic disrupted conventional career paths, Manna founded SciFii Inc. from a modest room in his family home, focusing on offline functionality and data sovereignty. He now serves as Managing Director at Dortrees Technologies Private Limited, driving initiatives in AI, quantum computing, blockchain and indigenous cryptographic research, including forensic and deepfake - detection tools under Project XEUS.Rejecting opportunities abroad to counter brain drain, Manna champions homegrown intellectual property over imported technology. He mentors innovators in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities and authored the autobiography "Reinventing the Wheel. Named among India’s Most Inspiring AI Leaders in 2025, he continues building technology that positions India as a creator, not merely a consumer, of global innovation.Kunal MittalKunal Mittal, CEOBuilding Business Bridges Through the India–UK FTAKunal Mittal, CEO, Akash Coke Industries Pvt. Ltd. represents a new generation of Indian entrepreneurs who see opportunity not merely in individual sectors, but in the intersections between businesses, markets and economies. With entrepreneurial interests spanning coal, steel, hospitality and other ventures, Mittal brings a diversified and pragmatic perspective to the evolving India–UK business relationship.For him, the India–UK Free Trade Agreement is more than a reduction in tariffs—it is a catalyst for cross-border enterprise. Greater market access can create new possibilities for Indian businesses across manufacturing, metals, hospitality, technology, services and consumer industries, while opening avenues for strategic partnerships and investment.Mittal believes the real opportunity lies in thinking beyond traditional exports. Joint ventures, global supply chains, technology collaborations and international expansion can help Indian enterprises build scale and competitiveness.His approach is distinctly entrepreneurial: identify emerging opportunities early, build strong partnerships and turn changing trade dynamics into sustainable business growth.The pages slugged ‘Brand Connect’ are equivalent to advertisements and are not written and produced by Forbes India journalists.

opening: India's growth story today is being written not just by policies and markets, but by the individuals steering change from the front.

Across industries — from technology and finance to healthcare, infrastructure, and manufacturing — a new generation of visionary leaders is reshaping how business gets done, blending bold ambition with grounded execution.
body: These are the changemakers who see opportunity where others see obstacles, who build institutions rather than just companies, and who are quietly setting the tone for India's economic trajectory in the years ahead.
This feature spotlights a few such names driving impact, innovation, and inspiration nationwide.

Umashankar SudarsanUmashankar Sudarsan, Founder & CEOWhy Enterprise Transformation Starts With Trusted Data Umashankar, Founder and CEO of AppBeez Infotech and Infiniqon Technologies, brings more than three decades of experience in enterprise technology.
His expertise spans revenue management, billing, CPQ, data governance, and technology modernization.
As organizations invest in AI and automation, he sees data quality as a leadership responsibility.
Inconsistent information can undermine decisions, disrupt operations, and limit the value of new technology.
Lasting transformation depends on clear ownership of data and the discipline to keep it accurate, consistent, and accessible.
For Umashankar, innovation should produce measurable outcomes: more reliable operations, better informed decisions, and value that endures as organizations grow.
He also mentors and invests in early-stage technology companies, with interests in AI, cloud infrastructure, and data platforms.
His broader vision connects responsible technology adoption with India’s Viksit Bharat 2047 ambition, emphasizing the digital capabilities and institutional trust needed for sustainable growth.
Vipul B Varshneya and Anuj VarshneyaVipul B Varshneya (MD) & Anuj Varshneya (Co-Founder & Director) With over 40 years of experience,their architecture has transformed spaces for generations.
With a focus on designing spaces that inspire, the goal is to use architecture to create a lasting impact on communities and the environment.
Their founded company, STHAPATI is a multidisciplinary architectural practice headquartered in Lucknow and New Delhi.
Their portfolio spans a spectrum of building typologies, from housing to large-scale urban developments across India and the globe—including the United States, New Zealand and Mauritius.

A leader in airport terminal design and public infrastructure, they are also known for master planning, commercial, institutional, and heritage projects — delivering design solutions that are visionary and rooted in context like IITs,embassies and central universities.
The projects seamlessly blend regional influences with cutting edge technology to craft universally relevant spaces.

At present Harsh Varshneya and Khushboo bansal are spearheading the company with the commitment to responsible architecture which drives to develop solutions that are both sustainable and forward-thinking, resilient, adaptable, and impactful.

Ashish V. KhemkaAshish V. Khemka, Chairman & Managing DirectorAshish V. Khemka comes from a third-generation entrepreneurial family with roots in the tea and timber businesses but chose to carve out his own path in pharmaceuticals.

More than two decades ago, he founded AMN Life Science with an ambition to build beyond the domestic market, focusing from the outset on international expansion, strong manufacturing capabilities and long-term partnerships.
That approach has shaped how he has grown AMN over the years.

Under his leadership, the company has expanded to three manufacturing facilities, including two finished dosage formulation plants and one API facility, and built a presence across more than 50 countries.
Today, AMN has over 1,000 registered products and 150 EU Marketing Authorisations, with regulatory capabilities spanning the EU, UK, Canada and Australia.
As the business has grown, Mr. Khemka has continued to expand its capabilities through integrated CDMO and CMO solutions, building AMN into a global pharmaceutical partner.
Dr. Raju DesaiDr.
Raju Desai, Chairman & Managing DirectorFor more than four decades, Dr. Raju Desai has been closely associated with the evolution of India’s plastics manufacturing industry.
As Chairman & Managing Director of Jyoti World and President of Plastindia Foundation for 2026–28, he brings an industry perspective shaped by manufacturing, technology and global markets.
His leadership at Jyoti World reflects a broader belief: India’s manufacturing opportunity lies not only in scale, but in deeper capabilities.

The company has built an integrated ecosystem spanning polymer compounding, tooling, injection moulding, profile extrusion, machining and product development, enabling it to work with global OEMs on increasingly complex applications.

Today, Dr. Desai’s focus extends beyond manufacturing capacity to the larger ecosystem by encouraging technology adoption, sustainable materials, skill development and stronger industry collaboration.
Smita ChatterjiSmita Chatterji, Founder & Group CEO Smita Chatterji has built a life across worlds that are too often treated as separate.
A painter, philanthropist and homemaker, she is also a first-generation entrepreneur and the founder and Group CEO of Centreax, a technology company with offices in Kolkata, Chennai and Manila.
Under her leadership, Centreax has developed digital solutions across banking, insurance, healthcare, education, agriculture, manufacturing, retail and hospitality.
Its AI-powered platform CentraDox brings greater clarity and accountability to enterprise decisions by keeping approvals, documents and the reasoning behind them connected.
Chatterji’s range of experience shapes the way she leads.
She brings an artist’s attention to design, a homemaker’s understanding of competing demands and an entrepreneur’s determination to solve problems.
A former chair of CII’s Indian Women Network in West Bengal, she also supports women entrepreneurs and wider opportunities in Eastern India.
Her story makes a compelling case for leadership built from more than one identity.
Prashant TiwariPrashant Tiwari, ChairmanMr.

Prashant Tiwari, Chairman of Prateek Group, is a first-generation entrepreneur and Civil Engineer who founded Prateek Group in 2005 with a vision to create landmarks and set new benchmarks in real estate.

Over more than two decades, he has steered the company into a trusted name in North India's real estate sector, driven by an unwavering commitment to quality construction, timely delivery and thoughtful design.
His leadership rests on strong values of transparency, robust engineering and a customer-first approach.
Under his guidance, the group has delivered landmark residential and commercial projects across the NCR, including developments in Noida and Ghaziabad, alongside a 40-acre integrated township.

Mr. Tiwari continues to push the boundaries of premium luxury and fine living, believing that the sky is the limit, and remains focused on creating lasting relationships built on trust, commitment and consistently delivered promises.
Dr. Mohana Rao PatibandlaDr.
Mohana Rao Patibandla, Founder & CEODr.
Mohana Rao Patibandla: Advancing World-Class Neurosurgical Care from Guntur.

An internationally trained neurosurgeon and healthcare entrepreneur, Dr. Mohana Rao Patibandla is Founder & CEO of Dr. Rao’s Hospital – International Institute of Neurosciences (IIN), Guntur, one of India’s leading standalone institutes dedicated to advanced brain, spine, stroke, and nerve care.

Following his neurosurgery training at Nizam’s Institute of Medical Sciences (NIMS), Hyderabad, he pursued fellowships across the United States spanning skull base surgery, pediatric neurosurgery, neuro-oncology, cerebrovascular and endovascular neurosurgery, functional stereotactic radiosurgery, and minimally invasive techniques.

His research has earned global recognition, including the Brainlab Neurosurgery Best Paper Award at the Congress of Neurological Surgeons (CNS), USA, Best Paper honours at MISSABCON and PASMISSCON, and the COSSCON Gold Medal for spine surgery research.

An International Member of the American Association of Neurological Surgeons (AANS) and Member of CNS, USA, Dr. Rao remains dedicated to bringing globally benchmarked, evidence-based neurosurgical care to India while advancing innovation, education, and patient outcomes.
Dr. Neelanjan MannaDr.
Neelanjan Manna, CTODr.

Neelanjan Manna: Building India’s Digital Future from First PrinciplesBorn in South Kolkata in 1997, Dr. Neelanjan Manna’s path from dismantling household electronics to pioneering deep-tech innovation embodies India’s self-reliance ambitions.
Shaped by a freedom- fighter grandfather’s rebellious spirit and a businessman grandfather’s pragmatism, he pursued cryptography and computer science at VIT, publishing the “Manna Cipher” in 2020.
When the pandemic disrupted conventional career paths, Manna founded SciFii Inc.
from a modest room in his family home, focusing on offline functionality and data sovereignty.

He now serves as Managing Director at Dortrees Technologies Private Limited, driving initiatives in AI, quantum computing, blockchain and indigenous cryptographic research, including forensic and deepfake - detection tools under Project XEUS.
Rejecting opportunities abroad to counter brain drain, Manna champions homegrown intellectual property over imported technology.
He mentors innovators in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities and authored the autobiography "Reinventing the Wheel.
Named among India’s Most Inspiring AI Leaders in 2025, he continues building technology that positions India as a creator, not merely a consumer, of global innovation.
Kunal MittalKunal Mittal, CEOBuilding Business Bridges Through the India–UK FTAKunal Mittal, CEO, Akash Coke Industries Pvt.
represents a new generation of Indian entrepreneurs who see opportunity not merely in individual sectors, but in the intersections between businesses, markets and economies.
With entrepreneurial interests spanning coal, steel, hospitality and other ventures, Mittal brings a diversified and pragmatic perspective to the evolving India–UK business relationship.
For him, the India–UK Free Trade Agreement is more than a reduction in tariffs—it is a catalyst for cross-border enterprise.

Greater market access can create new possibilities for Indian businesses across manufacturing, metals, hospitality, technology, services and consumer industries, while opening avenues for strategic partnerships and investment.
Mittal believes the real opportunity lies in thinking beyond traditional exports.
Joint ventures, global supply chains, technology collaborations and international expansion can help Indian enterprises build scale and competitiveness.
His approach is distinctly entrepreneurial: identify emerging opportunities early, build strong partnerships and turn changing trade dynamics into sustainable business growth.

stories.headline: The businesses redefining what’s possible in India
stories.title: The businesses redefining what’s possible in India
stories.summary: India’s next chapter of growth is not being written by any single sector. It is taking shape in art galleries and spice supply chains, in enzyme plants and hilltop resorts, in lecture halls and neighbourhood jewellery stores. What unites these stories is a willingness to question how things have always been done, whether that means making original art feel within reach, using technology to prove where a spice came from, or carrying a family legacy into a global export business. The leaders featured here come from very different worlds, but each is building something that widens what customers, communities and markets can expect from Indian enterprise.Aryaman Sethi: Changing How The World Buys ArtAryaman Sethi, Managing Director, AnYahh!! ArtIn India, original art is admired from a distance, not because it lacks appeal, but because it is perceived as unaffordable. Aryaman Sethi is challenging that assumption.As Managing Director of AnYahh!! Art, Sethi believes the journey to owning art begins with education, not a sales pitch. By helping people understand artists, styles, value and pricing, AnYahh!! replaces intimidation with confidence, and confidence with trust.With galleries in Delhi and Dubai, thousands of original works by Indian artists, free home consultations, rentals, EMI options, authenticity certificates and worldwide delivery, the brand is making art accessible and affordable without diminishing its value.For Sethi, the opportunity is larger than selling paintings. Every informed buyer can become a lifelong collector, while every collector creates visibility and opportunity for an artist. AnYahh!! is not asking India to spend more on art; it is showing people that original art was within reach all along.Follow here for more : https://www.instagram.com/anyahhartdelhi?stkn=MWgzcXEyZHgydzhmZA==Beyond the Spice Rack: Arshad Shajahan’s Ambition to Transform How India Sources, Trusts and Consumes SpicesArshad Shajahan, Founder, FLAVORA AiFor centuries, spices have travelled across borders and cultures. Yet for the consumer, much of their journey remains invisible.Arshad Shajahan wants to change that.Through FLAVORA Ai, which imports cassia, cloves, star anise and black pepper from Sri Lanka, Indonesia, Madagascar and Vietnam, Shajahan is building a technology-led spice company focused on traceability, food safety and smarter sourcing.“We don’t want to sell spices. We want consumers to know the story behind what they consume,” says Shajahan.His vision combines blockchain-based, batch-level traceability with QR-enabled transparency, allowing consumers to access information about origin and testing. AI could help identify adulteration risks and predict supply disruptions, while digital compliance can connect testing, customs and sourcing records.“We are not trying to make spices futuristic. We are trying to make the system behind them smarter,” he says.For Shajahan, the future of spices is about one thing: trust backed by evidence.Dr. Arpit Chopra Jain: Advancing a Modern Vision for HomeopathyDr. Arpit Chopra JainDr. Arpit Chopra Jain, M.D. (Homeopathy) and recipient of an Honorary Doctorate from the USA, is a distinguished homeopathic practitioner committed to expanding awareness and understanding of homeopathy. Dr Arpit Chopra Jain (MD Homoeopathy) Director of Aarogya Super Speciality Modern Homoeopathic Clinic Indore & Representative of Homeopathic Medicine for BRICS Countries at BCMFHe is associated with the renowned Aarogya Super Speciality Modern Homeopathic Clinic, where his work focuses on managing complex and chronic health conditions through homeopathic approaches.Over the course of his professional journey, Dr. Jain has received recognition from prominent Indian dignitaries, including Ex Vice President of India Jagdeep Dhankhar and Union Health Minister J. P. Nadda.A central part of Dr. Jain’s mission is to challenge misconceptions surrounding homeopathy and encourage greater discussion about its potential role in healthcare. His clinical work has particularly focused on patients with serious and complex conditions, including cases where surgical intervention may otherwise be considered.According to his professional profile, Dr. Jain has treated more than 3,000 complex cases. He plans to systematically compile and present treatment data to the World Health Organization (WHO) in the future, with the aim of contributing to broader international discussion and research concerning homeopathy.Through clinical practice, documentation and international engagement, Dr. Arpit Chopra Jain continues to pursue his vision of bringing greater global attention to homeopathy while advocating for evidence, research and wider professional dialogue.Arun Raam GowdaBuilding experience-led businesses while creating impact through entrepreneurship, innovation and community initiatives.Arun Raam Gowda, Actor, Entrepreneur and PhilanthropistActor | Entrepreneur | PhilanthropistArun Raam Gowda is an actor, entrepreneur, and philanthropist building a strong presence across hospitality, technology, entertainment, and social impact. Based in Bengaluru, he is known for creating experience-led ventures that blend innovation with customer-first thinking.Also known as Aru Gowda and Arun Gowda, his hospitality journey spans award-winning restaurants, breweries, lounges, and experiential destinations, including Atlantis Brewery, Sugar Factory Reloaded, and Bangalore Adda.Beyond hospitality, Gowda is actively building technology-driven ventures while continuing his association with cinema, bringing together business, creativity, and storytelling.He is the founder of the Arun Raam Foundation, which supports initiatives in education, healthcare, youth empowerment, disaster relief, and humanitarian assistance. During the COVID-19 pandemic, the foundation’s Surprise Van initiative delivered essential supplies and emergency support to those in need.Through his multi-industry journey, Arun Raam Gowda continues to unite entrepreneurship, innovation, entertainment, and meaningful social impact.https://share.google/EVoy5v64762b5YHlzDr M Nadeem Zafar Clinician and Faculty, Clinical PsychiatryDr M Nadeem Zafar, Academic Director, Arise Medical Academy, Faculty, DocTutorialsDr Zafar is a clinician and educator in clinical psychiatry, celebrated for a teaching style that is as engaging as fun to grasp . His ability to make complex clinical concepts memorable has made him a sought-after faculty member across borders.An internationally renowned educator, he has taught in ten countries and has spoken on global platforms, including the United Nations (SDG, 2023).He has been tagged as one of the most influential medical mentors. And recently he has been selected for the world leaders submit 2026, Oxford, UK for “Excellence in Medical Education and Academic Leadership Award”Mr. Ajay Badekar Director – Stone Water by ZuperAjay Badekar brings years of hospitality expertise to Stone Water Resort & Spa, blending international-inspired design, distinctive experiences and warm Indian hospitality in Karjat.Ajay Badekar, Director, Stone Water Resort & Spa, KarjatMr. Ajay Badekar’s entrepreneurial journey in hospitality has been shaped by a simple belief: memorable stays are created through experiences that go beyond the ordinary. For eight years, his Forest Club Resort in Karjat has redefined the hilltop getaway experience, featuring one of the country’s largest meandering pools. Its strong patron response inspired him to envision newer, more distinctive hospitality concepts.His connection with hospitality began much earlier through his family’s ancestral restaurant, Namak. Over the last 12 years, under his leadership, Namak has evolved into Karjat’s signature dining destination, celebrated for its untouched gourmet experiences and excellent hospitality.Today, as Director of Stone Water Resort & Spa, Karjat, Mr. Badekar is bringing this vision to a larger canvas, introducing international-inspired infrastructure and a distinctive resort lifestyle to Karjat. Inspired by Bali, its unique multi-layered pool concept is among its defining experiences. More than a resort, Stone Water is envisioned as a sanctuary of leisure, luxury and warmth for vacations, weddings and celebrations.Manoj Alankar Mandir: Adding Sparkle to India’s Most Memorable MomentsManoj Kumar, Founder, Manoj Alankar MandirManoj Alankar Mandir is bringing together tradition, elegance and contemporary jewellery choices for customers in Sikandarpur, Ballia. Founded by Manoj Kumar, the business has established itself as a destination for jewellery suited to weddings, festivals, celebrations, gifting and everyday wear. From necklaces and earrings to bangles, rings and mangalsutras, customers can explore a wide variety of designs under one roof. What further makes the experience attractive is the 5% making charges offer on all kinds of jewellery. By combining timeless Indian traditions with evolving style preferences, Manoj Alankar Mandir is making jewellery shopping more accessible and versatile. Every piece represents more than fashion—it becomes part of celebrations, memories and life's most meaningful moments.Follow here : https://www.instagram.com/manojalankarmandir?stkn=cm52ZmR6MW55ZDk4&utm_source=qrConclusionTaken together, these seven journeys show that redefining what’s possible rarely begins with scale. It begins with a clear belief about trust, access, experience or knowledge, and the discipline to build around it. From Delhi and Dubai to Bengaluru, Karjat and Ballia, these leaders are proving that ambition in India is no longer confined to its largest cities or most familiar industries. As their businesses grow, they are also raising the bar for the enterprises that will follow.The pages slugged ‘Brand Connect’ are equivalent to advertisements and are not written and produced by Forbes India journalists.

His clinical work has particularly focused on patients with serious and complex conditions, including cases where surgical intervention may otherwise be considered.
According to his professional profile, Dr. Jain has treated more than 3,000 complex cases.

stories.title: Supreme Court allows sale, manufacture of next-generation green firecrackers

NEW DELHI: Ahead of the festive season, Supreme Court on Wednesday paved the way for the manufacture and sale of next-generation joined green firecrackers after Centre's recommendation.
Commonly known as 'ladi', these were earlier banned by the court.
SC also said a separate order would be passed for Delhi and indicated that while the bursting of firecrackers would not be banned, the activity would not be allowed at all hours.

Additional solicitor general Aishwarya Bhati told a bench of justices M Sundresh and Prasanna B Varale that government had recommended that joined firecrackers, which complied with norms fixed by Council of Scientific and Industrial Research-National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (CSIR-NEERI), be allowed.
The issue of using barium chemical remains undecided as the ASG told the bench that field trials were on, and sought time till Oct 15.

Submitting the findings of CSIR-NEERI, Bhati said the report said 25 braids were burst in one second in conventional joined firecrackers whereas in next-generation joined firecrackers, only five braids were burst in a second.
Advocate Pranav Sachdeva, appearing for some manufacturers, assured the bench they would do so.
As the pollution crisis in winter has become an annual affair in Delhi, the bench said it would pass a separate order for the national capital.
Neither are we going to agree with you for a total ban nor are we going to allow it 24 hours," the court said.

A total ban would have a "sentimental effect", SC said, but allowing bursting of crackers throughout the day would have a "huge impact on every other living being, including old people, sick people and children"." We need to find a solution whereby we can give specified time and we can specify what crackers are to be used," the bench told the petitioner seeking curbs on the sale of firecrackers in NCR.
